text: 17 month old daughter, temp 39.9 just now under her arm. Snotty nose and sneezing all day. She's actually wide awake, sat on my lap watching the telly and babbling away like it's the middle of the afternoon, which is more than I can say for me. Haven't slept properly in two nights. Just want to know if that number on its own means we should be going in or if I can manage her at home
